title: Ling Yuan Appears
next_chapter_hook: When Ling Yuan's figure completely vanished into the night, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand suddenly trembled violently—the fourth page was turning itself open.

text.content: The blood characters on the silk wove蠕动，仿佛刚从伤口中淌出，尚未凝固。Chen Ji stared at that familiar handwriting, his fingertips unconsciously gripping tight—the stroke style was unmistakably the same shadow he had seen in countless nightmares. Outside the window, night wind surged, ruffling his robes, yet the light from the third page of the Tianji Record remained eerily steady, shrouding the entire meditation chamber in a layer of pale golden mist.

dialogue.content: "The Chen bloodline shall not perish... the bloodline shall reunite..." The voice of the Residual Soul Guardian drifted幽幽传来 from the first page of the Tianji Record, carrying a rare solemnity. "Child, this blood writing is not a prophecy—it is a covenant. Someone is using your bloodline to inscribe an irreversible oath."

text.content: Before his words finished, the candles in the meditation chamber all extinguished simultaneously. A terrifyingly cold pressure poured in from beyond the door, like a materialized mountain pressing down, and Chen Ji's spine instantly tensed—this was the aura of Foundation Building late stage, yet far surpassing any ordinary Foundation Building cultivator by at least tenfold! He spun around, instinctively tucking the Tianji Record into his sleeve, eyes slightly narrowed, his pupils reflecting a figure slowly walking in.

dialogue.content: "No need to hide." The old man's voice was hoarse yet full of vitality, each word striking Chen Ji's heart like a hammer. "I can smell the Tianji Record's aura from three li away." He stepped into the room, moonlight carving out a stern and weathered face—Ling Yuan, the reclusive old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful arc. "Chen Xuan's heir，果然在这儿。"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart missed a beat, but his expression remained utterly unchanged. He even managed a look of extreme panic, knees buckling as he was about to kneel: "Disciple... disciple had no idea the Sect Master would grace us with his presence..." His voice trembled slightly, the performance flawless. Meanwhile, the corner of his eye was rapidly measuring the distance between himself and Ling Yuan—three zhang. If the other struck, he would have at most half a breath's reaction time.

dialogue.content: "Stand up." Ling Yuan swept his sleeve, an gentle yet irresistible force lifting Chen Ji. "You've been acting this for three years. Aren't you tired?" His tone was calm, yet like a dull blade scraping the heart. "The one chosen by the Tianji Record, how could they truly be just a servant废物？Chen Ji... no, perhaps I should call you—Chen Xuan's grandson?"

text.content: Those last two words exploded in Chen Ji's ears like thunder. His pupils constricted sharply, the Tianji Record in his sleeve faintly burning—Heavenly Fate Value was visibly draining. He suppressed the raging waves in his heart, on his face showing three parts bewilderment and seven parts wariness: "What does the Sect Master mean? This disciple is merely an orphan, taken into the Sect as a child. How could there be any..."

dialogue.content: "Enough." Ling Yuan raised a hand to interrupt him. A withered palm flipped over, and an ancient jade slip appeared in his palm out of thin air. "This is the Chen Family Ancestral Temple's Bloodline Jade Slip, obtained by me thirty years ago. The seal upon it shows that Chen Xuan's son, Chen Nian, married Lady Su and had a son—" He paused, the murky old eyes flashing with keen light. "That son is you, this servant disciple."

text.content: A pin drop could be heard in the meditation chamber. Chen Ji's spine stiffened for an instant, then slowly relaxed. He raised his head, and on that face that had always been weak and timid, a genuine cold intent appeared for the first time: "So what? Does the Sect Master visit in the dead of night just to tell me this?" His voice was low, yet carried a trace of mockery. "Do you want to recruit me, or silence me?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly laughed—a hollow, bitter laughter, utterly different from his former majesty: "Silence you? If that were my intention, why would I wait until today?" He tossed the jade slip to Chen Ji. "Do you think the Tianji Record chose you for nothing? Before his death, Chen Xuan passed his inheritance to me, yet had the Tianji Record reject me—have you ever wondered why?"

choice.prompt: There seemed to be deeper secrets hidden within Ling Yuan's words. Chen Ji decided...

choices.description: A cold smile as he questioned: "Since the Sect Master knows the Tianji Record chose me, why not strike earlier? What tied your hands, or... are you also a chess piece of fate?"
choices.visible_reward: Draw Out Ling Yuan's True Stance
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan truly has malicious intent, this move would be equivalent to proactively revealing oneself

text.content: Ling Yuan's smile froze on his face, a flash of swift pain掠过 his murky eyes. He fell silent for a full ten breaths before slowly speaking: "Chess piece... indeed. Am I not also a piece?" His voice suddenly turned hoarse. "Do you think I am trapped in this Tianqing Sect for fifty years unable to advance? Because the moment the Tianji Record rejected me, fate inscribed shackles upon me."

choices.description: Sheathing his edge, he bowed his head: "This disciple is foolish and does not understand the Sect Master's words. However... if the Sect Master truly intends to take this disciple's life, I dare ask—may I know the truth before I die?"
choices.visible_reward: Cause Ling Yuan to Lower His Guard, Elicit More Information
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan doesn't fall for this, he may see through the act

text.content: Ling Yuan scrutinized Chen Ji, a glint of amusement flickering in his gaze: "This act of yours can deceive that little girl Su Qingyao, but not this old man." He paced to the window, moonlight stretching his shadow impossibly long. "But very well, since you wish to hear, this old man will tell you—there may be more between us than just rivals competing for the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan turned around. Moonlight condensed two cold sparks in the depths of his eyes: "Do you know why Chen Xuan chose me back then?" He didn't wait for Chen Ji's answer, continuing on his own. "Because my bloodline is identical to his—we are both Chen Family direct lineage, or rather..." His voice dropped lower. "We are both pitiful wretches chosen by the Eyes of Heavenly Way, then cast aside."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart shuddered violently. The Eyes of Heavenly Way—this name, Mo Xiansheng had whispered to him countless times, each accompanied by splitting headaches. He stared intently at Ling Yuan, trying to read truth from that aged face: "Does the Sect Master mean... you and I are also blood-related?"

dialogue.content: "Perhaps, perhaps not." A self-deprecating smile curved Ling Yuan's lips. "The Chen bloodline is so vast and scattered that it split apart a hundred years ago. But one thing is certain—" He stepped forward, his pressure suddenly intensifying. "The Tianji Record will never allow two qualified candidates to coexist in this world. I have been trapped at Foundation Building for fifty years unable to break through. Do you think it was due to insufficient talent?"

text.content: He abruptly raised his palm. Chen Ji felt a pressure in his chest, nearly causing him to spit blood. The Tianji Record in his sleeve convulsed violently, as if issuing a warning. Ling Yuan's palm palm faced him from afar, the old man's voice thundering in his ears: "Your existence is suppressing me! The Tianji Record can only have one master, and you—must die!"

choice.prompt: At this life-and-death moment, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: The Tianji Record rapidly flips, consuming 10 Heavenly Fate Value to glimpse three breaths ahead. Seizing the vision, he dodges the lethal strike and counters!
choices.visible_reward: Successfully Neutralize the Killing Move, Let Ling Yuan Witness the True Hidden Card
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is precious; using it here may affect future plans
choices.process_label: 以命相搏，展现真正实力

text.content: The Tianji Record flipped to the second page, golden light blazing! Chen Ji's eyes turned blood-red, his body mysteriously shifting three cun sideways a split instant before Ling Yuan's palm wind descended, narrowly evading the vital point. Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply: "This is... foresight power? You truly inherited the complete Tianji Record!"

choices.description: "Wait, Sect Master!" Chen Ji abruptly displayed the third page of the Tianji Record to Ling Yuan. "Look at these blood characters—'Bloodline reunites in three months.' Who do you think it refers to?"
choices.visible_reward: May Shake Ling Yuan's Killing Intent, Buy Time to Breathe
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may use this to deduce more Heavenly Secrets

text.content: Ling Yuan's palm wind froze mid-air. He stared fixedly at that line of blood characters, an unbelievable flicker掠过 his murky old eyes: "This handwriting... this is Chen Xuan's genuine script! How could he have left a contingency?!" His voice trembled for the first time. "Bloodline reunites... could there be a second Chen descendant?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan withdrew his palm force, his chest heaving violently, as if that single strike had exhausted most of his strength. He stared at Chen Ji, his gaze complex beyond measure: "Do you think this old man wants to kill you?" He suddenly burst out laughing, the sound凄厉. "If you die, the Tianji Record will choose anew, and this old man will still be the rejected one! Yet as long as you live, this old man remains trapped in this cage forever!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, yet his gaze grew increasingly clear. He looked at this old man tormented by fate for half a lifetime, and an odd resonance stirred in his heart: "So you came tonight not to kill me, but... to tell me the truth?"

dialogue.content: "What does it matter even if I tell you?" Ling Yuan's voice suddenly grew weary, all pressure dissipating, the man seeming to age ten years in an instant. "In three months, the Eyes of Heavenly Way will fully awaken. At that time, whether you or I, we are all merely discarded pieces on His chessboard." He drew a pitch-black token from his sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. "This is the Holy Sect's secret order, intercepted by me—your sister, Chen Nian, is in their hands."

text.content: The fingertips Chen Ji used to grip the token turned faintly white. Chen Nian—the sister he thought long dead, actually still alive? He raised his eyes to look at Ling Yuan, and a profound light flickered in the old man's gaze: "You and I are both chess pieces, both bound by the Tianji Record. In three months, if we cannot break this chess game..." He turned toward the door, his silhouette despondent. "The day of your death will be the moment of my awakening."

Ling Yuan's figure vanished into the night. Chen Ji stood alone in the meditation chamber, the token in his hand biting cold, the blood characters on the third page of the Tianji Record still trembling faintly. He closed his eyes, countless thoughts racing through his mind—bloodline reunites, the Eyes of Heavenly Way, his sister's whereabouts... Behind all this, what earth-shaking chess game was truly at play? Outside the window, the eastern sky was beginning to glow pale. A new day was dawning, and the game between him and Ling Yuan had only just begun.
